presets.label: A&R / creative
presets.description: Artists, releases, deals, contracts and the document generators. No money pages.

presets.label: Marketing
presets.description: Releases, the artist spend sheets and campaigns, and the Add tab so they can enter an invoice without seeing the queues.

presets.label: Bookkeeper / finance
presets.description: Invoices, Bank, Vendors, Reports, Recoupments and Artist Spend. No roster or release tracking.

presets.label: Executive (CEO, COO…)
presets.description: The label at a glance — roster, releases, deals and contracts, the money reports, recoupments, budgets and campaigns, People. None of the day-to-day queues.

presets.label: Ops / admin (everything)
presets.description: Every page, including the ones hidden from the sidebar. The same set an unrestricted admin sees.

roles.label: Superadmin
roles.short: Everything, including the label's secrets and other admins.
roles.who: The owner. Keep it to one or two people.
roles.pages: Reaches every page. Permission rows never bind a Superadmin.
can: Create, edit, remove and sign out Admin and Superadmin accounts, and grant any role
Set page access for Admins
Edit any person's sidebar, and each department's nav — the page list a group gets (Settings › Navs)
Write the label's EIN and bank account number (Settings › Label); everyone else sees them masked
View the app as another person (View as), and send from anyone's personal mailbox
Read, create and edit Restricted admin documents
Permanently delete an artist (Admins can only archive)
Download the full archive of the database and files (Settings › Archive)
cannot: Demote or delete the last Superadmin — the system refuses so nobody is locked out

roles.label: Admin
roles.short: Runs the label side of the dashboard and manages people.
roles.who: Operations leads and whoever administers the team.
roles.pages: Reaches every page until someone curates their page list; after that, the list is what they get.
can: Add, edit and remove Approvers and Users; send invites; force a sign-out; set their page access
Everything an Approver can do on invoices and payments
Bank statements, bank matching and bank flags (these carry account balances, so Approvers do not see them)
Label settings: the label record, integrations (mail, QuickBooks, DocuSign), Market Street reps
The Setup group on Flags (label record blanks, mail and integration health, invites) and Check now, which runs every check on the spot
Admin documents (except Restricted), Activity log, Analytics
Archive and merge artists and releases; delete anyone's chat message; see everyone's tasks
Full TINs in the 1099 export and the deleted-rows ledger
cannot: Create or edit another Admin or a Superadmin (the register API refuses it too)
Write the EIN or bank account number

roles.label: Approver
roles.short: A bookkeeping admin with no say over people or the app.
roles.who: The bookkeeper or finance lead who approves and pays invoices.
roles.pages: With no page list: Home, the Money pages, Recoupments and Campaigns. A curated list replaces that.
can: The whole Approvals page: approve, reject, edit, split, vendor aliases and merges
Mark invoices paid and edit payment details; read a vendor's bank details and TIN (each read is audited)
See every rep's invoices, not just their own
Reports, categories, artist budgets, campaign pay fields, contracts in search
Invoices they enter are approved on the spot instead of waiting
Edit or delete a label-issued invoice, an artist's contact details and deal files; hand a flag to someone else

roles.label: User
roles.short: Sees only the pages they are granted, and only their own invoices.
roles.pages: Home and Messages by default. Every other page is a grant, usually seeded by the department's preset when the account is made.
can: Everything on the pages they are granted, including detail pages under them
Invoices whose rep is theirs, or a rep an admin has shared with them
Enter invoices — they wait in Approvals as pending
Their own settings: profile, sign-in, notifications, mailbox, theme, sidebar
Delete their own messages and their own brand uploads
cannot: See another rep's invoices unless shared, or edit, attach to or open documents on them
Open a W-9 (a tax form belongs to the bookkeeping roles)
Edit someone else's task or delete their calendar event
Assign a flag to anyone but themselves

axes: What the API lets you do: approve, pay, delete, administer. Set on the person.
Which pages open. Granted per person, seeded by presets; a Superadmin bypasses, an Admin bypasses until curated.
Picks the default preset when the account is created. Never checked for access.
Orders task delegation (a task to someone senior is a request). Executives are level 1. Also gates permanent release deletes at level 2 or better.
